FFmpeg source code offer
========================

The libraries in this folder (avcodec, avutil, swscale, swresample) are part of
FFmpeg 8.1.2, built by Gyan.dev ("full_build-shared"). That build is configured
with --enable-gpl --enable-version3 and is licensed under the GNU General
Public License, version 3 (see LICENSE.txt in this folder).

The corresponding source code is available from:

  * FFmpeg release 8.1.2:       https://ffmpeg.org/releases/
  * Build recipe and sources
    of the bundled libraries:   https://www.gyan.dev/ffmpeg/builds/
  * Third-party components
    compiled into the build:    listed in the build's configuration line
                                (run "ffmpeg -version" from the same Gyan.dev
                                package) and available from each project.

The exact archive these files came from is pinned in
third_party/ffmpeg/provenance.json of the FRD repository
(https://github.com/KateY07/frd), together with its SHA-256.

If you received this package from the FRD project and cannot obtain the source
from the places above, open an issue at https://github.com/KateY07/frd/issues
and the maintainer will provide it. This offer is valid for at least three
years from the date of the release that contains these files.

FRD itself (FRD.exe, frd-wintools.exe) is not part of FFmpeg and is licensed
separately under the MIT License.
